coverageContext: Complete 45-term UK Biobank model for coded congenital deficiency of other clotting factors, including factor VII. Covariate-adjusted partial correlations were modest (about 0.038–0.056 in European groups and 0.035 in a South Asian group); case counts and detailed case definitions are not deposited. This polygenic sum does not identify a pathogenic factor-gene variant, establish carrier status, measure clotting-factor activity, diagnose a bleeding disorder or predict procedural bleeding. It must not guide anticoagulation, factor replacement or surgery. GA does not reproduce clinical covariates or disease probabilities.

Complete 40-term TPMI Han Chinese score trained on broad arthropathy codes, then evaluated for the deposited palindromic-rheumatism endpoint (719.3, M12.3, M12.4). Training and evaluation definitions differ; the evaluation code list also includes intermittent hydrarthrosis. Only 161 cases were included among 17,549 evaluated participants. AUROC about 0.882 includes sex, age, array and ten principal components, not genetic-only or GA performance. No European evaluation is deposited, so European reference ranks are withheld. This sum does not diagnose recurrent joint attacks, predict conversion to rheumatoid arthritis, or guide immunosuppression.
